ledger: glass bowl | clear glass bowl resting on wooden table | remains on wooden table | stays stationary throughout while camera slowly zooms in

colored balls in bowl | 8 visible balls in bowl at 00:00 (2 red, 3 yellow, 3 green) | 6 visible balls in bowl at 00:09 (3 red, 1 yellow, 2 green) | a 3rd red ball appears in child's hands at 00:01 and vanishes at 00:02; balls change colors and counts spontaneously while being stirred from 00:06 to 00:09
small metal cup and loose balls on table | resting on right side of wooden table at 00:00 | out of frame by 00:04 | leaves frame naturally as camera zooms in on the bowl

findings.description: At 00:01, the child holds a third red ball above the bowl while two red balls remain stationary inside the bowl (making 9 balls total). At 00:02, as the child lowers his hands, this third red ball vanishes into the center red ball, leaving only 2 red balls (8 balls total) in the bowl.

As the child stirs the balls from 00:06 to 00:09, the balls spontaneously change color and count: from 2 red, 3 green, and 3 yellow balls at 00:05, they shift to 3 red, 1 green, and 2 yellow balls at 00:07, then to only 1 yellow ball and a half-green/half-red ball at 00:08, and by 00:09 the yellow ball on the far right transforms into a red ball.
